title: release(ci): add artifact signing + provenance and release manifests for private-installer
author: Aisha Khan
description: Motivation: Harden Private Installer releases by producing signed artifacts, reproducible SBOM/provenance, and machine-readable release manifests consumed by the installer and customer air-gapped workflows. This PR implements an end-to-end CI path that builds release artifacts, generates in-toto provenance attestations, attaches PGP signatures, and emits a release-manifests.json used by the private-installer to verify and fetch staged artifacts. Changes include CI pipeline updates, a signing helper script, a small Go tool to generate SBOM/provenance bundles, Helm chart manifest templates, and Terraform module outputs to surface artifacts for downstream automation. This is intended to enable secure offline installs and facilitate auditability for regulated customers. Testing: Unit and integration tests for the provenance generator, CI smoke runs in staging that performed a canonical build and sign cycle, and a dry-run of the private-installer verification step using the generated manifests. Rollout: feature flagged; signing keys are stored in staging KMS and production rollout will gate on KMS access review. Backwards compatibility: manifests are additive; older installers ignore unknown fields. See linked linear tickets for rollout checklist and security review.
